title: Incorrect principal/resource authorization in a Swift server handler
preconditions: request principal and resource/role identifiers are checked in separate code paths
authorization result is derived from a route parameter or decoded request value
dangerous_transitions: incorrect subject/action/resource comparison authorizes a protected operation
sink_semantics: Vapor/NIO route handlers and service methods
resource read/write after a role, owner, or tenant comparison
counterevidence: Safe high-level Swift collection access retains runtime bounds checks.
The foreign pointer contract and owner lifetime are validated at the boundary.
verification_recipe: Trace the authenticated principal and selected resource through the exact policy branch.
Compare owner, cross-tenant, and wrong-role controls.
